Name: Laivellaliarn's Tonberries for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
At the request of Laivellaliarn, I've updated their Final Fantasy Tonberries (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16791]here[/url]) to work for 1.6!

Tonberries come in 4 varieties and live in coops. Every few days they produce:

- Tonberry: knife (basic), soul ember (deluxe)
- Bonnetberry: crimson knife (basic), blazing ember (deluxe)
- Paleberry: azure knife (basic), shining ember (deluxe)
- Voidberry: shadow knife (basic)﻿, dead ember (deluxe)

Enjoy!
